source: Captured in Chromium at 1280x800 (light) from the page in "page", written for this suite and styled with @picocss/pico 2.1.1 (css/pico.css, MIT). Baselines: tailwindcss 4.3.3 theme + Preflight, blank element under the parent's inherited values. States: real mouse hover.
page: Everything you need to launch, nothing you don't.
Unlimited projects, npm i acme and priority support.
